name: human-output
description: The contract for writing anything a person will read and decide from — a report, a finding, an answer, a request for a decision. Works on any subject: research, legal, finance, operations, planning, code. Referenced by other skills and invocable directly before a long piece of work. Trigger phrases: "/human-output", "remember I am a person not a machine", "write this for a human", "keep the reader in mind". Not /human-rewrite (repairs text that already exists) or /human-draw (builds a picture) — human-output governs writing as it happens.
